skills: H02 exponential tilt identity only; no saddlepoint probability approximation
L03 exact realized-dyadic oracle and selected old Fraction-function cross-check; no interval-certified MC law
source_law: Choose label using uniform integer 0..5: 0..2->k1, 3->k2,4->k4,5->k8. Each source coordinate independently uniform integer -A*k..A*k divided by k. Coincident fractional contributions sum to full original mu; W=1.
receiver_prior: Cn=1+n log2. Given y, core probability1/Cn: uniform y+[-.5,.5]^n. Shell probability nlog2/Cn: log r uniform [0,log2], face uniform 2n signed faces, free offsets uniform[-r/2,r/2]; q_y=sup_[1,2] h_L/Cn. dx=n r^(n-1)dr dnu (normalized boundary cone measure).
conditional_tilt: Given y, core/shell, r, signedface, partition actual free-coordinate intervals by finite k1 captured count at reference R*=1.5 exactly equal2. p_i actual interval length/r. Entire product mixture .25 base +.75 tilted, tilt factor T^sum_freeH/product_free(1-p_i+p_iT). Face H is recorded diagnostic but not RN. RN=1/[.25+.75 exp(logL)]<=4, complete base support. Core all coordinates free.
sampler_checks_before_mc: New actual high/low partition and finite-coordinate law checks using 4 configurations/n including support edges. Fraction DP RN mass/moment identity for actual p_i; sampler branch/status checks for every draw. No re-use of old 9 configurations as sampler certificate.
response_oracle: Store y and offset float.hex; interpret each realized offset as exact dyadic. Common binary denominator and integer arrival keys for every coordinate/atom arrival in[1,2], simultaneous grouped updates, full mixture mass. Compare candidate mass/R^n by integer cross multiplication; smallest R tie. Exact compare E=M>registered tau and fullsource capture. No radius grid.
new_original_oracle_crosschecks: Only 3 new actual receivers/n (source0 rep1 draw0; source0 rep2 draw0; source1 rep1 draw0), call imported old pure arrival_oracle on realized dyadic x. Never old main or old probes.
score: Z=1_E*1_capture*(tau/M)*h_R(x-y)/q_y(x)*RN <=4Cn; conditional expectation S(y) in ideal continuous exact model. Save S1,S2 per source. I1/W mean .5(S1+S2), I2/W mean S1*S2 from independent conditional replicas. S itself <=Cn.
confidence: Distribution-free Hoeffding simultaneous across 3 rounds, 2 outer means, all prefixes1..256: delta_outer=.025, union1536 estimates; score mean bound4Cn, product bound16Cn^2. Conditional S profiles from16 draws: delta_profiles=.025, union768 sources, range4Cn, clamp target to[0,Cn]. Total ideal-model coverage>=.95. All numerical proposal/log evaluations are non-interval; intervals are ideal-law statistical ranges, not certified floating/continuous integration error.
stopping: Fixed256 sources each/n; no data-dependent tuning, no expanded rerun. If execution interrupted externally retain completed prefix, apply pre-registered prefix-union CI and explicitly withdraw stopped-mean unbiasedness; do not restart old finished sources.
tail_diagnostic: Plugin mean(max(.5(S1+S2)-K,0)), K=sqrt(n),2sqrt(n), biased conditional nonlinear diagnostic; unlike I2 cross product it is not unbiased source-tail estimate. No tail/order conclusion.
diagnostics: source/receiver labels; offsets;r;core/shell;face/sign;global mixture branch;free p_i, log normalizer/logL/RN;actual H;reference face H
full winner R, mass, capture counts, E/capture; exacttie count, log runnerup gap and near threshold at1e-10
proposal RN ESS and score ESS; outer means and independent-replica discrepancy
sampled support edge and coincident-source summaries; full source profiles preserved
cost: 12288 new receiver calls total; per call O(n sum k) arrival generation and O(n kmax log(n kmax)) sorting; exact integers up to a few thousand bits. No q^n atom enumeration or n-dimensional grids. Expected minutes bounded fixed sample scope.
